footprint_target_cm.source: BP_PickupXP PickupMesh /Engine/BasicShapes/Cube (100 cm) x scale 0.3; big block scale 1.8 (root 0.54) applied in game, not baked

warnings: M_XPChipBig_core is emissive in Blender (strength 4, #FF26BF): the FBX does not carry emission, the Unreal material sets the glow (MI_PickupXPBig)

C1.evidence: Slab 30 x 30 x 3.4 cm (11 %), four tiles, seams read as steps. Differs: source seams are thinner and flush.

C2.evidence: Casing 18 cm (60 %), 4.5 cm above the board (15 %), thin darker ledge, short vertical wall then a 45 degree chamfer of 2.0 cm (44 % of height) to a 0.8 cm flat rim, plan corners cut; 4 triangular notches dip into the chamfer corners and read as dents in the render. Differs: the chamfer is shaded almost like the wall under this light so the bevel reads less strongly than the source, and the source notches are crisper small triangles.

C3.evidence: Core 12 cm (40 %) stepped faceted pyramid (vertical step, 45 degree slope, step, slope, flat top) in a square recess, magenta; steps visible. Differs: sunk deeper than the source so the lower step is hidden by the recess wall; no glow (not judged).

C4.evidence: 3 identical compact legs 2.1 cm wide on each of the two viewer-facing sides, leaving the wall at about half casing height, rounded elbow with 3 arc segments, small flat foot on the board, evenly spaced (4.4 cm). Differs: source legs are a little taller and chunkier with a boxier shoulder; ours are thinner strips.

C5.evidence: 4 flat-topped regular hexagonal bolts (6 equal sides, 3.2 cm across corners, 10 %) on a short wider base, light grey, clean facets in the render. Differs: source bolt heads have a small top chamfer.

C6.evidence: 5 light-grey traces 1.2 cm wide (4 %), 7.5 to 10.4 cm long (25 to 35 %), with one or two right-angle bends (one straight), raised 0.25 cm, clearly visible; 3 box components (two larger on opposite sides, one smaller), dark with a light band on top. Differs: source traces use 45 degree bends and run closer to the legs; source components are a bit larger.

C7.evidence: Board and casing gunmetal, legs, bolts, traces, bands light grey, core magenta #FF26BF, no cyan.

C8.evidence: 848 tris (max 1000), 30 x 30 x 7.9 cm, pivot bottom centre, flat shading, UV0 and LightMap UV1 checks pass.
